name: Unit conversion
definition: Changing between centimetres and metres, minutes and hours, or grams and kilograms means multiplying or dividing by the conversion factor. Deciding which of the two it is by asking should the number get bigger or smaller catches nearly every slip.
recognizeWhen: the lengths are given in different units
convert to the same units first
misconceptions: I multiplied when I should have divided and my answer was a hundred times too big.
I converted one of the two quantities and forgot the other.
I gave the answer in the units of the question rather than the units asked for.
